text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear claim in the introduction: \"I believe they would be a great development\"","quality":"explicit thesis","description":"It states a definite position up front so the reader immediately knows the essay’s argument."},{"evidence":"Body paragraphs on accidents and public transportation","quality":"organized reasoning","description":"It develops the position in separate points that are easier to follow than the other essay’s list-like flow."},{"evidence":"\"the car could help a great deal, and could save lives\"","quality":"argument elaboration","description":"It explains how the evidence supports the claim instead of only mentioning facts from the article."},{"evidence":"\"This would help transportation in cities and busy places would run a lot faster and smoother\"","quality":"coherence","description":"Its ideas connect more smoothly within and across paragraphs, creating a more unified argument."},{"evidence":"Introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion with a closing thought","quality":"essay structure","description":"It more clearly fulfills the expected argumentative essay format with a recognizable beginning, middle, and end."}]}
